notes.title: Release + A Little Patch
notes.content:
Hello Poco People!

Thank you so much for playing the game! The last 3 days since release have been a wild ride, and the team and I have really enjoyed seeing your reactions and reading all your kind words. We're so glad to see that people are appreciating our little game around the world.

I also noticed a few little bugs and glitches, so I just put up a patch to fix a few things. The biggest/most noticeable change would be that the dreaded rhythm game is a bit easier now, as the cracks heal in the button after a string of consecutive successful notes. I've also slowed the fishing minigame a bit. Hopefully these changes ease some of the frustration we've been noticing around.

Thanks again for playing!
Micah
